rationale: Links the wgpu-native webgpu target into pulp-render only when the renderer has no Skia Dawn archive (the existing Windows rule on every platform), and makes runtime staging and bundle build-info follow that link, so Skia-on images neither ship nor load libwgpu_native. Skia's static Dawn remains the only WebGPU implementation in those images; rendering output is unchanged (byte-identical Graphite renders measured). Tests and the consumption census follow the link. No render, Skia/Dawn, capture, design-import, or packaging authority moves to or from Vellum; this is Pulp-side hygiene (vellum-move P14) under the 2026-10-04 temporary Pulp exception, matching the accepted D4 refinement.
